settings.raw_html:
THE ROLE

01

Senior Designer

We're hiring a senior product designer to own interfaces for clients like Hexa Labs, from first flows to shipped screens. Based in Lisbon or remote in the EU.

02

What you'll do

Run discovery with clients, map flows, design and prototype product screens, grow design systems, and review the work each week with Tomás and the web team.

03

What you'll bring

Five or more years designing digital products, a portfolio of shipped work, fluent Figma and prototyping skills, and clear written English. Studio time helps.
